feed.title: Ecolab Life Sciences Opens New Resin Manufacturing Facility in China
feed.summary: Ecolab Life Sciences has opened a new resin manufacturing facility in Quzhou, China, expanding its global purification resin capacity and integrating manufacturing with an R&D and engineering center. This investment aims to meet the growing demand for advanced purification solutions in life sciences and critical industrial applications. The facility will accelerate innovation and support customers in improving performance while conserving natural resources.

feed.title: Navitas Extending GaN and SiC Strategy with Claros Acquisition
feed.summary: Navitas Semiconductor is set to acquire Claros, an integrated voltage regulator (IVR) and vertical power delivery (VPD) solutions company, for up to $232.8 million. This strategic acquisition aims to expand Navitas's serviceable available market, addressing the final power-delivery stage from 800V infrastructure to AI processors, and leveraging Claros's advanced IVR technology to solve power delivery challenges in high-performance computing. The deal is expected to boost Navitas's gross margins and integrate Claros's talent and intellectual property into its wide-bandgap strategy.

feed.title: Rambus Extends Caliptra with Production-ready Root of Trust for AI and Data Center SoCs
feed.summary: Rambus Inc. has introduced a production-ready version of its CryptoManager Root of Trust, which supports the Caliptra specification and is designed for security requirements in data center and AI system-on-chips (SoCs). This solution enhances the open-source Caliptra framework by integrating hardware security, cryptographic agility, and lifecycle management, providing a clear path for chip designers to achieve volume deployment while maintaining interoperability. The CryptoManager Root of Trust includes a secure RISC-V processor, protected memory, cryptographic accelerators, and supports certifications like FIPS 140-3 and SESIP.

feed.title: "Hoax": Nvidia CEO Puts Trump on Phone While Downplaying Dangers Of AI
